verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Your precious blood has paid for us all
You took our griefs and carried our sorrows

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
You are our hearts’ desire, come as the Healer
Shout Your name over us
You are the mighty Redeemer
You are the one we want, come in Your power
Shout Your name over us
You are the heart of the Father

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
You conquered death and You came back to life
So we’ll breathe our last but we’ll never die

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
No one wants to make things right more than You
Have it Your way, do what You long to do
Anything can happen when You move
So would You come and move here

verse.name: b2
verse.lines:
Shout Your name, shout Your name over us
Shout Your name, shout Your name over us
